question: Which region did Babur first conquer during his initial campaigns in India?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Bhira**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

__

• Babur’s first conquest in India was the region of **Bhira**, located in Punjab, which was strategically important for establishing his foothold in India.

• This conquest occurred in **1519**, during Babur’s early expeditions into the Indian subcontinent.

• Bhira provided Babur a base to secure his operations and enabled further campaigns in northern India.

• It was a well-fortified town, and its capture demonstrated Babur’s military strategy and organizational skills.

• The conquest of Bhira was part of Babur’s initial efforts to expand his empire and was a precursor to his later victories, such as the First Battle of Panipat in 1526.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

• **Panipat**

• The First Battle of Panipat was fought on **21 April 1526**, between Babur and Ibrahim Lodi.

• It marked the beginning of the Mughal Empire in India and was one of the earliest battles to use gunpowder firearms and field artillery in the subcontinent.

• Panipat was not Babur’s first conquest in India but was the decisive battle that established his dominance.

• **Lahore**

• Babur’s campaign in Lahore occurred later as part of his efforts to consolidate his empire after the First Battle of Panipat.

• Lahore was an important cultural and political center and played a significant role in the Mughal Empire’s administration.

• **Sialkot**

• Sialkot was another important city in Punjab, but it was not Babur’s first conquest during his campaigns in India.

• It became part of the Mughal Empire as Babur expanded his influence in the region.
